blocks.text: Notion-style website builder with AI-powered page generation

Typedream brings the simplicity of Notion to website building. If your team already thinks in blocks and databases, Typedream feels immediately familiar. The learning curve is essentially zero, which means you spend time creating content instead of learning a tool.

The AI page generation feature is genuinely useful - describe what you need, and Typedream generates a complete page structure with placeholder content. It is not going to replace a designer, but it gets you 80% of the way there in seconds, leaving you to polish the details.

For solopreneurs and small teams selling digital products, Typedream includes built-in payment processing. That means you can go from idea to revenue-generating page without stitching together multiple tools.
Notion-style editing with drag-and-drop content blocks
Describe your page and let AI create the initial structure and copy
Sell digital products and memberships without third-party tools
Integrated blog with SEO-friendly URLs and RSS feeds
Meta tags, social previews, and sitemap generation built in
For non-technical founders who love Notion, Typedream removes every barrier to getting online. The AI generation feature makes it even faster to go from zero to published.
Our team can integrate Typedream into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
